# opwan_usage (Data Source)

Data used in a calendar month (UTC), per day, and the live throughput. Bytes count both directions through the exit; a TB is 10^12 bytes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opwan_usage" "october" {
  month = "2026-10"
}

output "used_percent" {
  value = 100 * data.opwan_usage.october.used_bytes / data.opwan_usage.october.allowance_bytes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `month` (String) `YYYY-MM` (UTC). Defaults to the current month.

### Read-Only

- `allowance_bytes` (Number) The month's allowance.
- `days` (Attributes List) One entry per UTC day with traffic, oldest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--days))
- `live` (Attributes) The tunnel's live state, null without a tunnel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--live))
- `rx_bytes` (Number) Bytes to you.
- `tx_bytes` (Number) Bytes from you.
- `used_bytes` (Number) rx + tx, what counts against the allowance.

<a id="nestedatt--days"></a>
### Nested Schema for `days`

Read-Only:

- `date` (String) `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `rx_bytes` (Number) Bytes to you.
- `tx_bytes` (Number) Bytes from you.


<a id="nestedatt--live"></a>
### Nested Schema for `live`

Read-Only:

- `last_handshake` (String) The last WireGuard handshake (RFC 3339), null before the first.
- `rate_bps_rx` (Number) Bits per second to you, over the last report.
- `rate_bps_tx` (Number) Bits per second from you, over the last report.
- `throttled` (String) Why the speed is lowered right now: `none`, `burst`, `allowance` or `pacing`.
- `up` (Boolean) A handshake within the last 3 minutes.
- `updated_at` (String) When the exit last reported (RFC 3339), null before the first report.
